- **Redesigned browser extension popup**: see at a glance whether your phone
  is connected and over which path, which tab your commands go to, and the
  last command. A green dot on the toolbar icon means a phone is connected.
- **Extension update notices**: the extension now checks for new versions and
  walks you through updating (download, unzip over the same folder, Reload).
- **English first**, with Italian when your browser is set to it.
- One-time step: after installing this version, pair the extension once more.
  It now has a fixed id, so from here on updates keep your pairing.
